Skills catalog

Invoke any skill in your agent chat. Each one is a markdown file in your project's .agents folder.

Skills run in pipeline order. See the workflow guide for when to use each one, or get started to install them in your repo.

Architecture pipeline

SkillPipelineWhat it doesExampleStatus
/initializeArchitectureSets up your project environment and main instructions file.

											/initialize this project
> project main instructions
Available
/exploreArchitectureReverse-engineers legacy code for architecture insights (brownfield projects).

											/explore this codebase
> architecture insights
Available
/extractArchitectureExtracts real rules and conventions from your codebase to guide generation.

											/extract from this source code
> actual coding conventions
Available

Building pipeline

SkillPipelineWhat it doesExampleStatus
/specifyBuildingWrites clear specifications with formal acceptance criteria.

											/specify a feature requirement
> formal spec with acceptance criteria
Available
/planifyBuildingBreaks specs into concrete, ordered implementation steps.

											/planify the specification
> clear, ordered implementation plan
Available
/codifyBuildingGenerates code that follows your plans and your rules.

											/codify the plan
> code on feat/{slug}
Available
/verifyBuildingWrites and runs E2E tests so specs are actually met.

											/verify the code
> E2E tests that confirm specs are met
Available

Crafting pipeline

SkillPipelineWhat it doesExampleStatus
/reviewCraftingReviews code for quality and generates a feedback report.

											/review the source code
> actionable quality feedback report
Available
/repairCraftingFixes issues from review or verify reports.

											/repair reported issues
> fixed code issues
Available
/releaseCraftingBumps version, updates CHANGELOG and docs, marks specs released.

											/release a new version
> semver bump and changelog
Available
/repositoryCraftingManages git branches and conventional commits; invoked by other skills.

											Used automatically by /codify, /repair, and other skills
Available
/refactorCraftingImproves existing code without changing its behavior.

											/refactor the codebase
> better structure and maintainability
